With the movement towards more automated ML solutions like Google's AutoML,
TPOT, auto-sklearn and others, should we be worried about our jobs and how we
will add value? We got to discuss this topic during one of our GLAD (Glamorous
Ladies and Data) sessions. Jenna's answer: No! These automated systems can
open up our time as analysts and scientist to do more interesting analysis,
validation and address the bigger business problems. I totally agree with her
on this point! The more we are able to automate the most predictable and
consistent parts of our job, the more we free up our time to develop and
execute on more high impact projects and move towards a more proactive
mindset. Curious to hear your perspective.. hashtag#datascience
hashtag#machinelearning

One good way to start deep work is to wake early in morning because 1\. No one
will be there to distract you at that time. You don't have any chats coming
up, news feeds won't refresh so fast. (at least mine didn't) 2\. The early
morning energy boosts you up to do more. Focused attention achieves 10 times
more work. 3\. There were days, I completed by day's work by 10 AM. Within 2
months of hashtag#deepwork practise, I was able to design 800 hours long PG
curriculum for Data Science. This work , till date remains one of my best work
in curriculum design. I did this in 5 days - 5 hours each day starting 5 AM.
hashtag#deepwork is incredible !! Sachin Tripathi Venkatesh Gupta
